item.text: {"question_id":"8B.5","answer":"For Lula’s 2023 administration, the evidence shows mixed coordination rather than verified system-wide control. The Bolsa Família framework created formal intergovernmental execution, conditionalities, performance-linked transfers, federal inspection, and local social control, while the Yanomami response involved ministries, armed forces, federal agencies, and security bodies, with reported deployments, reopened posts, supplies, territorial operations, and a malaria plan (BATCH-0019-E003; BATCH-0013-E004; BATCH-0013-E006). Environmental governance also assigned formal competencies across nine ministries and restructured some participatory institutions, but only eight of seventeen mapped environmental councils were active (BATCH-0007-E010; BATCH-0007-E011). These records document institutional design, coordination efforts, and reported activities, not consistent compliance or completed milestones across the federal system. Implementation weaknesses included inadequate federal climate coordination, an inoperative interministerial sanitation committee, and serious CadÚnico supervision and municipal-execution failures (BATCH-0001-E026; BATCH-0005-E008; BATCH-0003-E009). The January 8 testimony further describes failures to activate the integrated protocol, crisis center, and operational plan, alongside fragmented intelligence communication; however, it is contested and does not establish Lula’s personal design, knowledge, or full causal responsibility (BATCH-0020-E021; BATCH-0020-E022). Thus, documented reach and coordination existed in selected programs, but the supplied evidence does not establish sustained cross-system compliance or reliable milestone
